en: Active: peak amount of video memory used during generation (excluding cached data)
Reserved: total amout of video memory allocated by the Torch library
System: peak amout of video memory allocated by all running programs, out of total capacity
create a gif in addition to .mp4 file. supports up to 30 fps, will self-disable at higher fps values

List of setting names, separated by commas, for settings that should go to the quick access bar at the top, rather than the usual setting tab. See modules/shared.py for setting names. Requires restarting to apply.
DeforumationQT controls the render. Click to render with Deforum's own settings only.
Deforum renders on its own. Click to let DeforumationQT control the render (start DeforumationQT first).
Start DeforumationQT itself: its mediator and its window. Its folder is remembered in deforumation_switch.json.
Change Animation mode and the video init while a render runs. Off: the render follows the project, exactly as before.
What the next frame does: the project's own Animation mode, 2D, 3D, or the video init on its own.
How much of the video init is mixed into every frame while the mode is 2D or 3D. 100% is the video alone, 0% is the animation alone.
DeforumationQT is starting. Its Mediator and Deforumation windows open in a moment.

en: How many frames the fade takes.
Fade the video init out to 0% over those frames, by itself, from the next frame on.
Fade the video init back in to 100% over those frames.
Which frame the fade starts on. 0 starts it on the next frame the render draws, so a long render can be set up before it starts.

en: At that frame: switch to that mode, and send the video init to that share over that many frames (0 jumps straight there). Mode: Deforum, 2D, 3D or Video. The frame can also be a time (1:30) or a point in the song picked in Audio Keyframes (beat 16, part 2).
